featured_reviews.name: ayushi Ojha
featured_reviews.review_text:
We hired Zero Gravity Photography for our engagement shoot and trusted them with preserving memories from one of the most important milestones of our lives.

When we recently reached out regarding our engagement photographs, we were informed that the data had been permanently deleted from their Google Drive and could not be retrieved.

We were told that the team previously maintained backups but stopped doing so after Google began charging for storage. If there was a change in their backup policy, clients should have been clearly informed before permanently deleting important event data.

Unfortunately, instead of a transparent and accountable response, our experience has been marked by defensiveness. Communication has also been inconsistent, with delayed replies and periods where our messages were not responded to, which felt evasive.

Engagement photographs are not ordinary files — they are irreplaceable memories. Professional photography services must have clear data retention policies, responsible backup systems, and respectful communication.

The loss of our engagement photographs is deeply upsetting, and the handling of this situation has been extremely disappointing.

featured_reviews.name: Harsh Trivedi
featured_reviews.review_text:
We are devastated to report that Zero Gravity Photography deleted our engagement photos in their entirety. Their reasoning? They chose to stop paying for backup storage and did so without notifying us or providing a chance to secure our files.
Key issues during this ordeal:
• Negligence: No data redundancy or backup systems in place.
• Poor Communication: They went "radio silent" and became defensive when confronted.
• Lack of Accountability: Zero effort was made to rectify the situation or provide a transparent apology.
Engagement photos are not just "files" , they are a milestone. This company treated them as disposable overhead. Save yourself the heartbreak and hire a professional who respects the weight of your memories.

featured_reviews.name: Mukul Dongre
featured_reviews.review_text: Thou its a good studio , its Not very good for big bands. Feels congested. Specially the design is little weird on wall. I hurt my   head whilst getting up from the kit the very first day. Then I got used to it and was careful. People are very good , very helpful. Good sound as well. I feel it’s good place if the band is smaller for rehearsals.. basically it’s a recording studio. So one can’t expect much for bigger bands.

One of the best space to come and get your music made .

featured_reviews.name: Godwin Emmanuel
featured_reviews.review_text:
Great studio for recording live gigs !!
Located at Khar and close to the railway station. My experience was amazing at the studio and the sound experience during the live gig was just awesome 😍

featured_reviews.name: Shadaab Kadri
featured_reviews.review_text: Great experience recording our set at Island City Studios. Friendly and super helpful staff and state-of-the-art facility.

featured_reviews.name: Khushboo Jain
featured_reviews.review_text: Had the best time here. The guy who was managing us had his first day at work but what a job done. All in silence, handling each question as it’s coming so calmly - the help he did for a 8 people jam was marvellous. We all had our own synths and he helped configure a lot of wiring and patching so all can have stereo and clocked in for staying in tempo. Lovely studio. Pls book it for all your group jamming session and mastering needs. I am going to book the studio again for my mixing and mastering session! So close to Khar station and a maintained property! Always call and let them know your needs they can better assist you!

featured_reviews.name: Viraaj Saxena
featured_reviews.review_text: The best place in the city. Great gear, great people, this studio’s epic!!

featured_reviews.name: Temsu Jamir
featured_reviews.review_text: State of the art Studio in Mumbai. I was there with my band for Maed in India Session.. and wow! Such a great vibe in there..Wizards of Sound Engineers and staffs in there..and that's where all the magic happens.

featured_reviews.review_text: Awesome place to jam and record quality is just awesome
